title: Degrees of Prolongation Varieties of Monomial Planar Systems
description: LaTeX source, figures, checking scripts and data for the paper Degrees of Prolongation Varieties of Monomial Planar Systems. For x1' = x2^p, x2' = x1^q with p, q >= 2 the paper computes the degree of every prolongation variety in closed form, answering Questions 6 and 7 of G. Pogudin's open problems in differential algebra for this family and proving Puddu's conjecture.
